title: Introducing AI Specifically for Traders - SefironAI
author: PloniAlmoni2021
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/1cyl3bzmh9eh1.png?width=1846&format=png&auto=webp&s=9ec5e79d088ebabb7b7380ae72e1841a3b58c3d7

Dev here - I'd like to introduce my first financial product for Software Sunday: **[Sefiron AI](http://sefironai.com)** 

**Sefiron is an AI-powered financial research platform.** Think of it as a Bloomberg-terminal-inspired research assistant: you ask questions in plain English about stocks, SEC filings, market data, and more — and it does the multi-step research for you, returning a sourced answer with live charts and citations.  
  
Financial research today is fragmented and slow. An analyst or investor typically juggles a market-data terminal, a regulatory-filings database, a short-interest data provider, a spreadsheet for custom math, and a web browser — then manually stitches it all together.  
  
Sefiron collapses that workflow into one natural-language interface. Instead of pulling data from five tools and assembling it yourself, you ask one question. Sefiron plans the research, gathers data from the right sources in parallel, runs any custom calculations, and hands back a single answer — with charts and citations so you can trust and verify it.  
  
We can help with stock screening, fundamental and technical analysis and even portfolio construction!  
  
If you have a specific workflow (i.e. your alpha) we make it easy to define a persona and workflow that will run YOUR repeatable process.  
  
We're currently in Beta and would love some members of the community to try us out. It's free to signup (full transparency - you have a limited number of tokens), but if you try out the system, and provide valuable feedback we'll gladly send over more!  
  
If you like the product and signup over the next week, use the code **REDDIT75** for 75% off for your first 3 months!

[Sefiron AI](http://sefironai.com)

comments.author: littlepark123
comments.body: Hi! Out of curiosity, was your website built using AI/vibe coding? I’m always a bit cautious about quality before diving into new tools. Also, how does this differ from just asking Claude directly?

replies.author: PloniAlmoni2021
replies.body:
Hi! Thanks for the response.

Short answer: yes, I did use AI to help with the code.  
Slightly longer answer: I've looked at almost all the code produced, made sure it matched my spec, ensured it was tested and spent a lot of time iterating to make sure everything works well. Most every dev I know uses AI to write code and the real differentiator is in product and architecture.

As to your second question. Yes, you could use Claude, but Sefiron AI is a big shortcut. Claude misses a lot when you have to bring in proprietary data sources, especially around markets. If you happen to know where to look, and what you want you could replicate a lot of what I did but it'll cost you in time.

Of course, if you have a very specific workflow that you can use Claude for, then it would make sense to do it once, have Claude document it and you're set. If you are more exploratory Sefiron AI could help!
